San Francisco
signal & traffic corpus

Published signal timing cards, engineering plans, transportation models, and observed traffic data. Search the source collection and jump directly to promising pages.

Read the evidence in context. Timing cards are dated records; transportation studies include existing and proposed scenarios. Modeled cycles, actuation, and priority settings are not live red-light observations. This is a research corpus, not a verified current citywide timing database.

The search box covers document titles and timing excerpts. For complete extracted text, use the local SQLite FTS index:

python corpus/scripts/query.py 'Synchro AND Existing'

python corpus/scripts/query.py '"Ocean Avenue"' --limit 20

PDF page numbers are one-based. Workbook results use sheet sequence numbers. OCR is marked and should be checked against the original scan.

All files remain local. No account, tracking, or network connection is required to search this catalog. Original-source links require internet access.
